description: Object /profiles (API.md §11): the profiles' queries and commands. Step 5g.2 lands compiler_cache (the protocol-10 query profile_cache stays as its v0 alias); step 5n (part B2) set_device and clear_device; step 5o (part B2) set_active, create, tool_choices, add_tool and remove_tool. list and query are deferred.

compiler_cache.description: The compiler cache the profile resolves for one of its projects, as lw profile query <profile> <project> cache prints it; cache is absent when the project's module does not cache C/C++. Probes the client's PATH. An unknown profile, a project the profile does not map, or a stale id is the refused result.

set_device.description: Set the profile's device to one of Devices/1.list's devices (API.md §11, §15), persisted as the profile's device (its serial) in the working copy (user.json, never loomworks.json), as the in-process Profile:set_device writes it, in a model segment of the caller's environment; the write's model_change (Workspace/1 changed) precedes the reply, and Devices/1 changed and the views' update follow. An unknown or stale profile or device, or a refused or failed write (a stale or untrusted working copy, a refused load), changes neither the file nor the model: the refused result.

device.description: The device: its id, or its key (the serial).

clear_device.description: Remove the profile's device from the working copy, as set_device writes it (the same segment, signals and refusals).

set_active.description: Make the profile the active one (spec §4.2), as the in-process Profile:activate does, in a model segment of the caller's environment: Workspace/1 changed and header_changed precede the reply. An unknown or stale profile, or a refused or failed write, changes neither the file nor the model: the refused result.

create.description: Materialize a profile of the configuration set (spec §4.1): a { candidate } set is added first; tool one of tool_choices' toolchains (absent: a profile without one, shown incomplete); an existing profile of that set and toolchain is returned, not duplicated. A new profile's intent is local; with activate it is also made active. While a toolchain detection is running it is refused at once with 'toolchains are still being detected' (exit code 1; retry), never waiting. SDK toolchains are not yet accepted (a later change). A toolchain not among tool_choices', an unknown or stale set or a changed candidate is refused. When the automatic set was added but the profile could not be saved, the result is ok with config_set, without profile, and with a warn note (API.md §4.1).

config_set.description: The configuration set: a reference (its id, or its key — its name), or { candidate }, the token ConfigSets/1.candidates gave for an automatic set.

tool_choices.description: The toolchains a profile of the configuration set can use, detected in the client's environment (the keyed toolchains of its projects' module types); SDK toolchains are not yet offered (a later change). While a toolchain detection is running it is refused at once with 'toolchains are still being detected' (exit code 1; retry), never waiting. Changes nothing. An unknown or stale set or a changed candidate is refused.

config_set.description: The configuration set: a reference (its id, or its key — its name), or { candidate }, the token ConfigSets/1.candidates gave for an automatic set.

add_tool.description: Add a toolchain to the profile. Its key is derived again (spec §1.6), its id kept; the new key propagates as a profile rename does, under the workspace operation lock (spec §19.3). A toolchain the model does not know is refused with "no toolchain '<key>'". An unknown or stale profile, a held lock, or a refused or failed write changes nothing: the refused result.

remove_tool.description: Remove a toolchain from the profile; as add_tool. A toolchain the profile does not have is refused with "no toolchain '<key>' on profile '<key>'".

OkProfile.description: The profile made (or the existing one of that set and toolchain).

config_set.description: The automatic set a { candidate } added (a created entity, API.md §4.1); absent for a set named by reference.

ToolChoices.description: The toolchains a profile of the set can use.
